contract: Family core of the AI model Pieces: pure provider-neutral values and validators (model reference; unit-tagged usage with amounts as non-negative integers or :unknown, cache writes per TTL from a closed grammar, the provider's input-token convention and source; the accounting identity input_uncached = input when input excludes cached tokens, input - cache_read - sum(cache_writes) when it includes them, prompt_input = input_uncached + cache_read + sum(cache_writes) only when every component is known, otherwise :unknown; a cache hint whose tenant must equal the dispatch tenant; provenance; refused and unknown failure classes; job reference and job state; stream chunk). No I/O.
limits: Values and validators only: no provider call, pricing, cost, metering, streaming or job lifecycle.
The cache-hint tenant rule stops a caller from naming another tenant's hint; it cannot partition a provider's own prompt cache between tenants that share one credential.
The accounting identity is checked by finite table tests on the documented Anthropic and OpenAI usage examples and listed missing-component cases; no proof is claimed.

grounding.claim: Listed scenarios: the accounting identity on Anthropic's documented usage example (Prompt caching, 1-hour cache duration: input 2048, cache read 1800, writes 148 at 5m and 100 at 1h) and OpenAI's (Prompt caching, Monitor cache performance: input 12000, cached 4000, writes 3000 at 30m and 4000 at 12h, 1000 ordinary), fetched 2026-11-09; :unknown for each missing component and for an inconsistent includes-cached report; cross-tenant cache hint refused; unit, TTL, job-state and stream-chunk validators; errors never echo input. Finite scenarios, not proofs.
Relies on Elixir 1.20.4 String.valid?/1 and Regex for text checks; not a local proof.

Each provider Piece translates its documented usage fields truthfully into raw counters and reports an absent field as :unknown; the documented input-token convention of each provider is as its documentation states.

telemetry.contract: Pure values and validators with no ambient configuration, observations or running lifecycle.
